name: RecurringTransaction
description: Schedules the creation of transactions, sets up reminders, and creates reusable transaction templates in QuickBooks Online Essentials and Plus.

operations.name: Create a recurring transaction
operations.description: Creates a recurring transaction. A RecurringTransaction object must have at least one line that describes an item and a DepositToAccountRef. If the billing address is not provided, the customer address is used. TaxCode.CustomSalesTax cannot be used as TxnTaxCodeRef.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm ID) for the QuickBooks Online company.

requestBody.description: The minimum payload for the underlying transaction type (e.g. Invoice, Bill) plus the RecurringInfo element. The transaction is wrapped in a key matching its entity Type (Bill, Purchase, CreditMemo, Deposit, Estimate, Invoice, JournalEntry, RefundReceipt, SalesReceipt, Transfer, VendorCredit or PurchaseOrder).

attributes.name: RecurringInfo
attributes.description: Describes the recurring schedules for transactions.

operations.note: The request body is keyed by the underlying transaction entity Type (e.g. Invoice). Supported types: Bill, Purchase, CreditMemo, Deposit, Estimate, Invoice, JournalEntry, RefundReceipt, SalesReceipt, Transfer, VendorCredit, PurchaseOrder.

operations.name: Delete a recurring transaction
operations.description: Deletes the RecurringTransaction object specified in the request body. Include a minimum of RecurringTransaction.Id and SyncToken. You must unlink any linked transactions associated with the object before deleting it.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm ID) for the QuickBooks Online company.

queryParams.name: operation
queryParams.description: Must be set to 'delete' to delete the recurring transaction.

requestBody.description: The transaction wrapped in a key matching its entity Type (e.g. Invoice), containing the Id and SyncToken of the object to delete.

attributes.name: SyncToken
attributes.description: Version number of the object. It is used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. Attempts to modify an object specifying an older SyncToken fails.

operations.note: Deletion is performed via the query parameter operation=delete on the POST endpoint. The request body is keyed by the underlying transaction entity Type (e.g. Invoice).

operations.name: Query a recurring transaction
operations.description: Returns the results of a query against RecurringTransaction objects using a SQL-like select statement (e.g. 'Select * From RecurringTransaction').

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm ID) for the QuickBooks Online company.

queryParams.name: query
queryParams.description: The select statement specifying the data to return, e.g. 'Select * From RecurringTransaction'.

operations.name: Read a recurring transaction
operations.description: Retrieves the details of a RecurringTransaction object.

pathParams.name: realmID
pathParams.description: The company ID (realm ID) for the QuickBooks Online company.

pathParams.name: recurringtransactionId
pathParams.description: The unique identifier of the RecurringTransaction object to retrieve.
